compared: public 2027 (same source): counted unit is Theorem label MT, statement lines 90-110 with proof lines 578-731. That is a short exact sequence of quotients of D(1,(k+1)theta) plus a mixed fusion-product isomorphism; it does not state how D(1,k theta) is presented, and the present proposition's statement (396-425) and proof (426-442) lie entirely outside the counted spans. The main theorem's proof uses this presentation, so the direction of dependence is the opposite one.
the source's Corollaries c1 (lines 113-123), c2 (124-131) and truncated (150-162) are direct corollaries of Theorem MT and are deliberately not counted; the source itself says so at lines 733-734.
source lemma garland (270-277) is a cited result of Garland (see also Chari-Venkatesh, Lemma 2.3) with no author proof in this article, so it is supplied here only as context, not as a counted claim.
